title: Pizza

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Pizza
source.note: Đã rút gọn và đơn giản hoá nhẹ một số câu; thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Pizza is an Italian food that was created in the area of Naples, in southern Italy. A pizza is a piece of flat bread covered with sauce and different toppings. The sauce is usually made from tomatoes. Some of the most common toppings are mozzarella (a kind of cheese), sausages, pepperoni, vegetables and herbs. The bread part is called the “pizza crust”.
In June 1889, the Neapolitan chef Raffaele Esposito created the “Margherita” in honour of Queen Margherita. It was the first pizza to include cheese.

Italian immigrants brought pizza to the United States in the late nineteenth century. The country’s first pizzeria, Lombardi’s, opened in 1905. After World War II, many soldiers came home from Italy and wanted to buy pizza. Since then, pizza has become more and more popular in the U.S. Thirteen percent of Americans eat pizza on any given day.

Today, pizza is an international food. The toppings are different in different parts of the world. Some people put pineapple, egg, chicken, fish or kimchi on pizza. Pizza can also be made without meat for vegetarians, and without cheese for vegans.
